note: Appearance passports of famous bodies (src/world/celestial/surface/AppearancePassport.h). The generator keeps the relief and pattern from the physical descriptor; mean_albedo_linear is the observed mean surface colour (linear reflectance), procedural = draw the generator instead of the curated / cached maps (author 2026-11-11: Io, Europa, Phobos, Deimos look better procedural, colour to be matched). 2026-11-11 (author): every Sol body with a synthetic placeholder map goes to the generator by passport; only Earth, Moon, Mars, Jupiter keep real curated maps.
